remarks: Bright, sunny, and move-in ready, this beautifully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment offers comfort, convenience, and modern amenities throughout. Features include a private entrance, central air, two dedicated parking spaces, and a spacious living room with hardwood floors and a wood-burning fireplace. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, including a refrigerator and electric range. The generously sized bedroom is complemented by a spacious bathroom with stackable laundry. A large basement provides excellent additional storage. Conveniently located near I-95, the Merritt Parkway, Stew Leonard's, restaurants, shopping, and public transportation. Available immediately. No pets. No smoking. Move-in condition. Schedule your viewing today!
